definitions: A series of Intel microprocessors designed for AI PCs, featuring an integrated Neural Processing Unit (NPU) for accelerated artificial intelligence tasks.
Intel's brand name for its line of high-performance mobile and desktop processors, succeeding the 'Core i' series, with a focus on power efficiency and AI capabilities.
examples: The new laptop is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 9 processor.
Intel Core Ultra brings dedicated AI acceleration to consumer devices.
Many manufacturers are adopting Intel Core Ultra for their next-generation devices.
